title: Percent of an amount
prompt: Return percent percent of amount. For example 10 percent of 200 is 20.
signature: func solve(amount: float, percent: float) -> float:
starter:
func solve(amount: float, percent: float) -> float:
	return amount
hint: Percent means per hundred: multiply, then divide by 100.
solution:
func solve(amount: float, percent: float) -> float:
	return amount * percent / 100
